name: Baekje Historic Areas
description: Spread across Gongju, Buyeo and Iksan in mid-western South Korea, these eight sites preserve the last two centuries of the Baekje Kingdom (475–660 CE). You can walk the hillside fortress walls of Gongsanseong, see the mounded royal tombs at Songsan-ri and Neungsan-ri, and visit the ruins of the Jeongnimsa and Mireuksa temples. Together they show how Baekje blended Chinese, Japanese and Buddhist influences.
